d:
Rus ke rashtrapti vladimir putin 17 navanbar ko tin din ki yatra par chin ke shahar shenjhen pahunche. vah yahan eshiya-paisiphik ikonomik koopreshan phoram men shamil hone ke lie pahunche hain. amerika ke rashtrapti donald tranp bhi chin pahunch chuke hain. 19 navanbar ko putin, tranp aur chin ke rashtrapti shi jinping tripakshiy baithak men hissa lene vale hain. rus ko amerika aur chin ke sath batchit se kya ummiden hain? rusi midiya is tripakshiy baithak ko putin ki kutnitik jit kyon bata raha hai? aaj pahli khabar men isi ki bat.
Riport: bibisi monitring
Prodyusar: surbhi gupta
